properties.project_name: Mission Bay Ferry Landing -- WETA/Port ferry terminal under construction
properties.digitized_from: No Assessor block/lot exists for this Port/WETA ferry facility (confirmed: DataSF's 'Parcels - Active and Retired' Socrata dataset, acdm-wktn, has no PIER-numbered street_name entries near this site). No Port/WETA/SFCTA GIS shapefile or site-plan figure was available, so this is a coarse locational box centered near Agua Vista Park (801 Terry A. Francois Blvd, a real, addressed park immediately next to the project per the Port's own project page), using the real DataSF street-centerline address range for that stretch of Terry A. Francois Blvd (data/raw/official_street_centerlines.geojson).
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- a coarse placeholder box, not a traced footprint, for the same reasons as data/manual/pier70_dry_docks.geojson (no parcel, no source figure). Primary sources describe the site only as 'adjacent to the intersection of Terry A. Francois Boulevard and 16th Street... adjacent to Agua Vista Park' -- no source found calls this site 'former Pier 64' (a distinct, still-separate 'Pier 64 Sediment Cleanup' line item appears in the Port's own draft Five-Year CIP), so this box is NOT placed at Pier 64 and that claim is not repeated in this record. The box does not represent the real ferry landing's true shape (a floating dock projecting into the Bay plus upland improvements) or its full extent.
properties.why_no_real_parcel: Port/WETA ferry facility; not on the Assessor's secured roll (data.sf.gov acdm-wktn has no PIER-numbered parcels near this site).
properties.regulatory_context: A WETA/Port of San Francisco ferry terminal project. Marine demolition of derelict piles (Phase 2a) was reported complete in 2025; ferry-landing and upland construction (Phase 2b) is under way, with completion targeted by the end of 2027. The San Francisco County Transportation Authority approved sales-tax (Prop L) funding toward the project, including a further allocation reported in April 2026.
properties.notes: This is a Port/WETA transit facility, not an OCII Mission Bay South development block -- grouped under the Mission Bay South site here because that is the nearest tracked site and because DataSF's official 'Former San Francisco Redevelopment Agency Project Areas' boundary (data/raw/redevelopment_project_areas.geojson) for Mission Bay South extends north along the Terry A. Francois Blvd shoreline to include this stretch (contains this location; see the PR body's geometry test). Recorded as adjacent rather than tracked because it is Port/WETA transit infrastructure, not a Mission Bay OCII development parcel like this site's other tracked records.
properties.digitization_method: 2026-09-28 -- CREATED as a coarse locational box (see accuracy_caveat and digitized_from), anchored near Agua Vista Park's real address on Terry A. Francois Blvd, then shifted well east (further into the Bay, consistent with a floating dock projecting past the shoreline) both to clear the 490/499 Illinois St building's and P23's real, already-tracked footprints (check_geometry_quality.py --strict) and to give a clean margin against check_raw_vs_processed_touching.py --strict, which otherwise flagged the smaller initial gap to P23 as an unresolved raw-vs-processed mismatch. No owner review yet; this box's exact position is the least reliable part of this record -- treat it as a locator, not a survey.
